title: Live like Ali
body:
Live like Ali
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
ALLAH loves all who have love for Muhammad(saww)
in their heart
He is the city of knowledge, Ali(as) it's door and
path
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain(as) and Prophet Muhammad(saww) can never
be a part
Because this is what Muhammad(saww) had said off
from the start
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain(as)-o-minni wa aana minal Hussain(as) Hussain(as)
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
For life and death they are the guidance and
philosophy
The sacrifice of Hussain(as) and the way of life of
Ali(as)
You only need to look at the final sujood of each
This is the art of life and death we should try to achieve
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
These were the words of Ali(as) "Fuzztou bey Rabbil Kabaa"
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain(as)'s the one who's the meaning of courage, love and peace
He owns the earth and he owns everything within the
seas
He is the path to the heavens this is a gurantee
To love Hussain(as) is the best way to let your soul be free
<<MINI>>
Hussain(as)yo
<<DIVIDER>>
We follow him cause he guides us to what we looking for
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
When growing up we have been taught this lesson everyday
Whithout a doubt you have been born to serve the Ahlulbayt
For loving them you may face torture, agony and pain
But everytime you should never be scared to face that hate
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
the Bravery of Ali(as) is what you should always show.
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
By sacrificing his companions and his family
Hussain(as) has showed us how to live our lives and how to be
To give whatever we have in ALLAH's name we'll see
There's not a thing in this whole universe we can't achieve
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
To live our life in the way of ALLAH should be our goal.
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
Our aim in life is to do good and to discourage wrong
This is the best way to let Karbala live on and on
And even through we know that fourteen centuries have gone
The sacrifice of Hussain(as) lives on in us and our soul
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
By standing for what he stood for this answering his call
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain(as)'s ultimate meaning of faith and devotion
He showed us how to conduct ourselves as creation
And then by saving humanity gave us salvation
This is a lesson for every age and generation
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
Because of him we have got harmony within our souls
<<MINI>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
Live Like Ali(as) Die Like Hussain(as) To call ourselves the lovers of these person Ali(as)ties
We have to follow them and should reflect on what they did
To fast and keep up with our prayers is imperative
These are the acts that go together with azadari
<<MINI>>
Hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
Without one or the other faith cannot be whole
